focus: sk-doc: map its five routing mechanisms and test the claim that packet Keyword triggers lines are the synchronized source of truth

graphEvents.label: Which copy of a routing decision is authoritative?
Two hubs name opposite sources of truth
Packet trigger lines and hub-router projection disagree on 17 terms

label: Two hubs assign opposite authorities to the same stage-one vocabulary: sk-doc/SKILL.md:53 makes each packet Keyword triggers line the source of truth with mode-registry.json and hub-router.json as synchronized projections, while sk-code/SKILL.md:54 makes mode-registry.json the single source of truth; whichever wins, one hub model is wrong today.

Nothing parses the declared source of truth: a search of every cjs/js/ts/py/mjs file under .skilled and .pi for "Keyword triggers" returns zero code hits, and the machine reader router-replay-lib.cjs resolves modes from hub-router.json and leaves from ROUTER.md, so the Keyword triggers line is prose enforced only by review.

The synchronized-projection claim is false: of 173 backticked terms across the 14 sk-doc packet Keyword triggers lines, 17 are absent from the union of hub-router.json vocabularyClasses, with sk-create-diff worst at 5 of 7 absent (document before/after review, before/after document diff, review document edits, docx diff, pdf diff) and every /create:* and /doc:quality slash form absent as well.

Stage two is hub-owned in sk-doc and packet-owned in sk-code on the same decision: only 5 of 14 sk-doc packets carry a RESOURCE_MAP block (sk-create-benchmark:115, sk-create-frontmatter:80, sk-create-repo-rule:89, sk-create-skill:106, sk-create-with-human-voice:89) while the other 9 depend on ROUTER.md section 3, whereas all four sk-code packets carry blocks and the hub block duplicates them; both shapes pass the same checks today.

sk-doc forbids the hub-level move the advisor report proposes to test: SKILL.md:65 states the machine block must not move into SKILL.md because the replay would treat it as the hub own router and lose the mode projection, and not into hub-router.json because of the schema handoff-ambiguity rule; that constraint is hub-level only, so moving a packet own block inside its own SKILL.md remains permitted.

JSON cost grows with the mode count: sk-doc spends 605 lines of mode-registry.json and 477 of hub-router.json for 15 modes and 152 aliases (about 40 registry lines per mode), sk-code spends 130 and 83 for 4 modes and 83 aliases (about 33 per mode), so alias drift is a function of mode count and a per-hub JSON shape must be generated or budgeted for that growth.

Readability: sk-doc/SKILL.md:53 is a 107-word two-stage run-on that defines routing, both stages, the advisor handoff and the separation rule in one paragraph, and sk-create-frontmatter/SKILL.md:36 packs 28 ungrouped trigger terms mixing field names, error symptoms and version formats into one line.

Hub shape already diverges inside the same family: sk-doc carries leaf-aliases.json (5 alias entries) and leaf-scopes.json beside leaf-manifest.json, sk-code carries only leaf-manifest.json, and leaf-aliases.json is read by router-replay-lib.cjs and parent-skill-check.cjs, so the two hubs are not interchangeable inputs to the same guards.

direction: Treat the Keyword triggers line as an enforceable source of truth
reason: No code reads it; the proposal would need a new parser to become checkable (f-iter002-002).
